description: Korean Delight is a simple addon for Farmer's Delight that introduces various traditional and modern Korean foods and ingredients to Minecraft.
body:
# Korean Delight

**Korean Delight** is an addon for [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight). This mod introduces traditional Korean crops, ingredients, and a rich variety of iconic Korean dishes.

### Ingredients & Intermediates
* **Chili Pepper** 🌶️
* **Chili Powder** 
* **Gochujang** *(Crafted in the Cooking Pot)*
* **Garlic** 🧄
* **Sesame Seeds** 🌱
* **Sesame Oil** *(Obtained by pressing Sesame Seeds in the Press)*
* **Green Onion** 🧅
* **Soybean** 🫘
* **Soy Sauce** *(Crafted in the Cooking Pot)*
* **Meju Block** *(Crafted in the Press)*
* **Tofu** *(Crafted in the Press)*
* **Salt** 🧂
* **Fish Cake** *(Crafted in the Press)*
* **Rice Cake (Tteok)** 
* **Kimchi** *(Crafted in the Cooking Pot)*

---

### Foods & Dishes
* **Kimchi** 
* **Tteokbokki** *(Returns an empty bowl after eaten)*
* **Doenjang Jjigae (Soybean Paste Stew)** *(Returns an empty bowl after eaten)*
* **Jeyuk Bokkeum (Spicy Pork)** *(Returns an empty bowl after eaten)*
* **Buldak-bokkeum-myeon (Hot Chicken Flavor Ramen)** *(Returns an empty bowl after eaten / Grants Fire Resistance for 30 seconds)*
* **Yangnyeom Chicken (Sweet & Spicy Fried Chicken)**
* **Bulgogi**
* **Bibimbap** *(Returns an empty bowl after eaten)*
* **Janchi-guksu (Feast Noodles)** *(Returns an empty bowl after eaten)*

---

### Contributed by 
Design contributed by lunar_windy

# Korean Delight (한국어 설명)

**Korean Delight**는 [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)의 애드온 모드입니다. 이 모드는 한국의 전통 작물과 식재료, 그리고 이를 활용한 다양한 대표 한식 요리들을 추가해 줍니다.

### 식재료 및 1차 가공품 (Ingredients & Intermediates)
* **고추 (Chili Pepper)** 🌶️
* **고춧가루 (Chili Powder)** 
* **고추장 (Gochujang)** *(냄비 요리로 제작)*
* **마늘 (Garlic)** 🧄
* **참깨 (Sesame Seeds)** 🌱
* **참기름 (Sesame Oil)** *(압착기에 참깨를 넣어 획득)*
* **대파 (Green Onion)** 🧅
* **대두 (Soybean)** 🫘
* **간장 (Soy Sauce)** *(냄비 요리로 제작)*
* **메주 (Meju Block)** *(압착기에서 가공)*
* **두부 (Tofu)** *(압착기에서 가공)*
* **소금 (Salt)** 🧂
* **어묵 (Fish Cake)** *(압착기에서 가공)*
* **떡 (Rice Cake / Tteok)** 
* **김치 (Kimchi)** *(냄비 요리로 제작)*

---

### 완성 요리 (Foods & Dishes)
* **김치 (Kimchi)** 
* **떡볶이 (Tteokbokki)** *(섭취 후 빈 그릇 반환)*
* **된장찌개 (Doenjang Jjigae)** *(섭취 후 빈 그릇 반환)*
* **제육볶음 (Jeyuk Bokkeum)** *(섭취 후 빈 그릇 반환)*
* **불닭볶음면 (Buldak-bokkeum-myeon)** *(섭취 후 빈 그릇 반환 / 30초 동안 화염 저항 버프 제공)*
* **양념치킨 (Yangnyeom Chicken)**
* **불고기 (Bulgogi)**
* **비빔밥 (Bibimbap)** *(섭취 후 빈 그릇 반환)*
* **잔치국수 (Janchi-guksu)** *(섭취 후 빈 그릇 반환)*

---
